scenes.line: Meet ICMBOT, the ICM coach for tournament poker.
Sign in, and everything you need is one click away.
Set your stacks, blinds and speed,
then pick the eight bots you want to face.
At every decision, the ICM coach shows the right move, and why, and grades the move you make.
Step away whenever you like. Continue table takes you right back.
Go against the coach, and you'll know it.
My Mistakes collects every decision the coach would play differently, with the reason.
One click, and you're back at the table.
Study spots with the ICM calculator, ranges and your statistics.

endCard.line: ICMBOT. Practice only, no real money. Start training free at icmbot dot one.
